name: Shiwa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shiwa town emblem in black: three lozenges arranged around a centre.
history: Municipal flag of Shiwa, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 July 1955.

features.role: Shiwa town emblem — three lozenges arranged around a centre
